title: Kissed Crispy Indian Bresaola Skewers
description: A crispy and earthy Indian dish featuring bresaola, perfect for kids and adults alike, with a smoky cold flavor profile and nut-free friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together ghee, garam masala, coriander powder, cumin powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced bresaola to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Thread the coated bresaola slices onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 12 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and brush with lemon juice.
Return the skewers to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until crispy.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for 2 minutes before serving.
